n: Theaters of the Street' stages opened

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages

list: Small lights shaped like the white flowers commonly found in Minos. Young patients who come in often ask for the flowers' names, and Lena warmly answers their questions.

A flowerbed based on the ones at Minos's winner podium, pots specially designed to resemble their traditional amphorae. The hero Flora planted seeds preserved in a clay vase all over the barren valleys to revive them after a disaster.
A long rug made to look like stone, with eroded textures printed on the surface. Traces of the raid on Athenius are clearly visible, but new stories await those in the city.
A long table carved from raw stone, simple and practical. The branch office is new and Lena is drowning in her endless tasks, but she will not stop her work.

A hanging lamp fitted with a paper shade. The light filtering into the room through the sheer gauze is incredibly soft. 'Fret not, just close your eyes, have a good rest, and tomorrow you're sure to be better.'
A simple bed for patients, with a soft and comfortable mattress. Illness can make one lose hope in one's future, and all Lena does is to help them regain the courage to face life again.
An hourglass-shaped stool with only a plain cloth in place of a cushion. One day ice and snow will melt into the rivers, trees will sprout new buds, and the people will find their own aspirations.
Flooring made of stone from the peak of Mount Athos, with calming qualities. The house of Athopoulou once used a similar design, and today, Lena stands on similar flooring with her brand new ideals.
Keep your noggin safe, starting with protective gear.
theme: A room recreated based on the Rhodes Island branch office Perfumer set up in Athenius. In the city encircled by lush mountains, Lena dispels past confusion and embarks on a journey to write a new chapter of recovery and rebirth.

list:
You met heroes in Athenius and bore witness to a revenge.
The snow on the peaks will melt, and the rivers will flow again, just as new stories of heroes continue to be written.
During the Medjehtiqedti Bound event, obtain the free Operator Varkáris

You earned Xanthos's trust with your wisdom and courage.
He knows the canal inside and out, but is not always in control of the river of his own heart.
During the Medjehtiqedti Bound event, consume 4000 Ostracon

You experienced the voting of Athenius and collected many ostracons.
'We express our collective will by voting. It is a fair and just way of making decisions—so long as truth is in the hands of the many.'
Complete all stages in [Ritual of the Temple] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

Your courage and spirit have earned Minos's approval.
Keep the Minoan spirit in mind and bring it home, or to every corner of Terra that needs it.
Complete all the content in [Classic Plays] and collect the rewards

Your dealings with the Astynomos of Athenius have helped you understand the ideals and methods of this reformer.
She does not care if she is understood, nor if there is anyone to walk with her. All she believes in is her own direction.
Perform a total of 500,000 healing during the event

The acolytes appreciate your help in refilling the fountains during your trip to Athenius.
'I keep tripping over myself on the streets these last few days... Fortunately, someone seems to have been refilling the fountains! I wonder who this good soul is?'
Defeat a total of 50 'Hero's Call' during the event

On the bustling streets, you have learned to immerse yourself in dramatic performance, and distinguish reality from illusion. The citizens of Athenius are most impressed by your willpower.
We do need hopes and dreams from time to time, though.
Complete all stages in [Theaters of the Street] on Challenge Mode

You participated in a complete dramatic performance on the street from noon till nightfall, and did so with full passion.
'That tourist really loved theater, or at least they loved the legend of Kereseira. How committed do you have to be to stay through three straight shows?'
Clear ME-EX-1 with a 3-star rating and all Fountains at max HP

You witnessed a perfect opener, a rarity in street performances.
Just getting a full cast together is difficult enough, and you even made sure that the fountains were filled and giving off a gentle fragrance!
Clear ME-7 with a 3-star rating, and have a Palladulis hit terrain at least once when charging while Immersed

'Charge until you hit their shield wall!'
The two citizens playing Palladulis appreciate your excellent work.
set:
An Engraved Medal Set that records a heroic tale of revenge in Athenius.
The wounds of the earth will heal, and we will take up poems again, but hatred is not so easily forgotten.
